description: This file manages keychain storage operations related to push relay registration and device attestation, including loading, saving, and clearing registration state and key identifiers.

classes.name: StoredPushRelayRegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the stored state of a push relay registration, including various device and relay information.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A static struct providing methods to load, save, and clear registration states and key IDs related to push relays and device attestation.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads the push relay registration state from the keychain storage, decoding it into a RegistrationState object.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Saves a given RegistrationState object into the keychain storage.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the stored registration state from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored App Attest Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves a new App Attest Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Removes the stored App Attest Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored Attested Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Stores a new Attested Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the stored Attested Key ID from the keychain.
